summary: Every gate passes. The full test suite passes, the sim id and COOP_PROTOCOL match live, the build works and the secret scan finds only the known library false positive. Smoke, home and Halloween e2e pass (Halloween once a load flake was rerun). The sweep covered 218 screens (fresh, mid and maxed saves at 844x390 and 1280x720) with no console or page errors and no crashes, no clipped text and no broken art. Nothing in the sim, online, systems or save code changed. The patch note is correct in id, version, date and position. Two medium findings block the release, and both are copy-only fixes. (M1) The first lesson a new player gets, 'Welcome home, Sensei', still says 'Tap ‹ › to change who keeps you company, and the picture button to pick a background'. The Quiet Home has neither control: both now sit under Menu > Background. (M2) A locked full illustration in the background picker still shows a toast and tooltip saying 'date her and give gifts in the City to unlock' (src/data/lobbyArt.js:221). That breaks the rule that Sensei is a friendly teacher and never romantic. The text is already live, and this release fixed the same wording in bgPicker.js but missed this line.

findings.title: The first home lesson tells new players to use controls the Quiet Home no longer has
findings.detail: Finishing (or skipping) the tutorial unlocks lesson 1, 'Welcome home, Sensei'. On the first home arrival it is announced with the toast 'Hikari has a new lesson ♡ — Welcome home, Sensei', and it heads the Captain's Journal. Its body says 'This is our home base! Tap ‹ › to change who keeps you company, and the picture button to pick a background.' (src/data/story/lessons.js:25). Its 'Hikari explains' scene says 'Tap ‹ › to choose who keeps you company. The picture button changes the view.' (src/data/story/scenes/lessons.js:14). The Quiet Home has no ‹ › chevrons and no picture button. Who keeps you company and the background both live in Menu > Background now (lobby.js header comment, menuSheet tools). So the first thing the release teaches about its headline feature is wrong. Suggested copy, display only and outside the sim hash: 'Open the Menu and tap Background to choose who keeps you company and the view behind her.' The lobby.js comments at lines 4 and 92 still mention the ‹ › chevrons; they could be tidied in the same pass.
findings.evidence: Captain's Journal screenshots at 844x390 and 1280x720 for fresh, mid and maxed saves (for example fresh-844x390-23-journal.png and maxed-1280x720-23-journal.png in the reviewer's scratch folder). Home screenshots show no chevrons and no picture button. grep: '‹ ›' appears in player copy only in those two lines.

findings.title: 'date her' romantic wording still ships in the background picker's lock toast and tooltip
findings.detail: src/data/lobbyArt.js:221 unlockText() returns 'Bond Lv N with <girl> (now n) — date her and give gifts in the City to unlock'. bgPicker.js uses it as the tile title (tooltip, bgPicker.js:107) and as the toast when an owned girl's bond-locked full illustration is tapped (bgPicker.js:110). On a student's tile this frames Sensei romantically, against HANDOFF §6 (Sensei is a friendly teacher, never romantic; bond scenes are wholesome). The text is already live on v0.1.53, so this is not a regression. But the candidate ships it, and this release fixed the two sibling strings in bgPicker.js ('Spend time with her & give gifts in the City', 'raised by time together and gifts') and left this one. Fix: 'spend time with her and give gifts in the City to unlock'. That is data copy outside the sim hash, so the sim id and COOP_PROTOCOL stay as they are.
findings.evidence: git diff origin/main...HEAD -- src/ui/lobby/bgPicker.js (the sibling fixes); src/data/lobbyArt.js:221 (unchanged since commit 1e3b54f5, on main); bgPicker.js:107 and :110 call unlockText.

findings.detail: 'Every story scene now plays in its own painted place' is true for the opening, the lessons and chapters 1-8. The Halloween event episodes (src/data/events/scenes/halloween.js, two scenes with bg 'academy-night') still use the tinted academy painting, and they are on show right now. Something like 'Every chapter scene…' would be exact. Optional.
findings.evidence: grep bg: in src/data: halloween.js:7 and :38 'academy-night'

findings.title: Patch note does not mention that most screens' top bars now hide coins and gems
findings.detail: src/ui/wallets.js: in the ink kit the top bar shows only the currencies a screen spends. The home shows tickets, coins and gems; the girl page and the Backpack coins and gems; Recruit tickets and gems; the Mall the active shop's. Hubs, lists, the roster, stage prep and the rest show none. Players will notice that the coins and gems they used to see everywhere are gone from Missions, Formation, Commissions, Mail and so on. A short bullet such as 'Top bars show only the currencies that screen uses' would set expectations. Optional.
findings.evidence: src/ui/wallets.js SCREEN_WALLETS / MALL_WALLETS. Sweep screenshots: the Missions, Formation and Commissions bars have no wallets.

findings.title: Two e2e scripts flake on a loaded machine (not a product fault)
findings.detail: halloween.mjs at 1280x720 once got an empty battle feed within its 90 s wait for the practice line. home.mjs once hit a 30 s page.screenshot timeout. Both happened while the 218-screen sweep ran beside them, and both passed in full when run alone. A comparison on one machine shows the Quiet Home is cheaper to capture than the live home (1280x720 screenshot 4.7 s vs 8.5 s; 1 running animation vs 12), so this is not a performance regression. Raising those timeouts or retrying the screenshot would make the gates steadier. Optional.
findings.evidence: Reviewer scratch logs halloween.log (1 FAILED) and halloween2.log (all ok), home.log (TimeoutError at home.mjs:336) and home2.log (215 ok); perf comparison of main and release with a seedInkSave home.

notes_for_owner: Not yet: two small text fixes first. Everything else about the Quiet Home and the painted story places looks good. All the tests pass, nothing about battles, co-op or saves changed, and I found no errors or broken screens across 218 screens on new, mid-game and maxed saves, at phone and desktop sizes. The Halloween event still works. The two blockers are wording only. (1) Hikari's first lesson still says to tap ‹ › and a picture button on the home, but the new home has neither: both are now in Menu > Background. (2) Tapping a locked full illustration in the background picker still says 'date her and give gifts in the City'. That was already live, but it goes against the friendly-teacher rule, and this update fixed the same phrase elsewhere in that window and missed this one. Both are one-line changes that qualify for the fast lane (display only, the sim id stays the same) and then need a fresh go/no-go. If you like, the patch note could also say 'every chapter scene' (the Halloween episodes keep the old academy backdrop) and mention that top bars now show only the currencies each screen uses.
